from collections import Counter
import sys

p, a = sys.stdin.read().splitlines()

count_p = Counter(p)
count_a = Counter(ch for ch in a if ch != '*')

print('S' if all(count_a[ch] <= count_p[ch] for ch in count_a) else 'N')
